description: Is the EMBER 2018 -> EMBER2024 drift ranking confounded by the v2 <-> v3 schema translation?

definitions.n_embedded_mz: v2: count of b'MZ' anywhere in the file; v3: strings containing '!This program ' (dos_msg)
definitions.n_paths: v2: 'c:\' case-insensitive anywhere; v3: strings matching r'\bC:/' (forward slash, case-sensitive)
definitions.n_registry: v2: 'HKEY_' anywhere; v3: strings matching r'\b(?:KHEY_|KHLM|HKCU)'
definitions.n_urls: v2: 'http(s)://' anywhere; v3: strings matching the thrember url regex (also ftp)
definitions.has_signature: v2 LIEF flag; v3 SECURITY data-directory size > 0
definitions.has_debug: v2 LIEF has_debug; v3 DEBUG data-directory size > 0
definitions.has_tls: v2 LIEF has_tls; v3 TLS data-directory size > 0
definitions.has_relocations: v2 LIEF flag; v3 BASERELOC data-directory size > 0
definitions.has_resources: v2 LIEF flag; v3 RESOURCE data-directory size > 0

parity_system32.corpus: C:\Windows\System32 (benign; deterministic every-k-th sample of PE files <= 8 MiB)
parity_system32.note: PSI between two definitions on the same files depends on the share floor when one definition puts every file in one bin; exact agreement and total variation do not.

n_embedded_mz.definition: v2: count of b'MZ' anywhere in the file; v3: strings containing '!This program ' (dos_msg)

n_paths.definition: v2: 'c:\' case-insensitive anywhere; v3: strings matching r'\bC:/' (forward slash, case-sensitive)

n_registry.definition: v2: 'HKEY_' anywhere; v3: strings matching r'\b(?:KHEY_|KHLM|HKCU)'

n_urls.definition: v2: 'http(s)://' anywhere; v3: strings matching the thrember url regex (also ftp)

parser_parity: LIEF 0.9 vs pefile on the same benign files: see extractor_parity_join (results/extractor_parity.json)

group_matched_random.design: draw i trained with seed i % 3, compared with the full and top-k models of the same seed; plug-in metric differences on the full test sets
group_matched_random.p_value_note: one-sided Monte Carlo p = (1 + #draws at least as extreme) / (1 + #draws); mc_p_topk_more_damaging tests whether removing the top-k hurts more than a random draw
group_matched_random.p_value_correction: mc_p_topk_more_damaging / mc_p_topk_less_damaging recomputed from the draws after the run: the script at e364c99 had the two labels swapped (fixed in bench_drift_parity.py); draws and all other fields are as written by the Actions run

threshold_note: ROC-read metrics; no thresholds are calibrated in this script
